summary: Started the long-video feed for How Tech Works: moved 8 long topics out of the Shorts feed, added 2 fast-growing ones (rocket engines, NVIDIA's AI chip), and studied long titles.
why: The long feed was missing, and the 8 long topics sat where Studio doesn't read. All 10 are blocked by the from_short rule because the channel has no Short with 100+ views, so the owner was notified.

findings.title: Every long topic blocked by from_short
findings.detail: The channel's only Short has 25 views; the rule needs 100+. Studio can't make this week's 2 long videos.

findings.title: Question titles hit 23% vs 10%
findings.detail: Niche scan, 216 long videos; digits in titles 10% vs 15%.

changes.title: 10 long topics in longform/topics.json
